Quiz: What will happen when the following CSS is applied to a table?

```css
table {
    border: 1px solid black;
}
```

Tap an option below to answer:

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Correct Answer!

The property sets a solid black border of width 1px to the table. This applies only to the outer border of the table.

The property sets a solid black border of width 1px to the table. This applies only to the outer border of the table.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

##### Incorrect, give it another shot!

The given CSS only affects the <table> element; it doesn't affect inner elements such as rows or cells. If you want to apply borders to individual cells, you would need to use additional CSS rules targeting those specific elements.
